text:
devon: quick q — how are we treating patch bumps for ops-only changes (deploy scripts, ci config tweaks, release notes text) vs minor? i'm about to cut a 0.13.x and want to be consistent

maria: if it's strictly internal/backwards-compatible bugfixes or infra-only, patch is fine. no API contract changes -> patch. :+1:

tyler: agree. also if we toggle a default flag or change user-visible behavior, it should be minor (semver minor). small perf/infra improvements still patch unless they change defaults.

amit: note for Dedicated customers: they sometimes pin to MAJOR.MINOR so go-minor can trigger extra ops. communicate in release notes and slack channel if you do a minor.

ellie: question on tagging: we've seen some CI tooling choke on tags with "+" (build metadata). currently some teams push tags like `v0.13.7+build.4882` — bad idea?

tyler: i'd avoid plus in tag names for release tags. Git supports it but downstream tools (artifactory, some deploy scripts) parse poorly. keep tag as `vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH`. put build id in annotated tag message or a release asset.

devon: consensus forming. also how do we name hotfix branches? we today use `hotfix/0.13.x` and then bump patch. any objections to `hotfix/0.13.7` style?

amit: prefer `hotfix/0.13.7` — explicit patch target reduces ambiguity.

sre-oncall: reminder: if this touches runtime behavior or routing fallbacks, respect change window for Dedicated -> prefer weekend low-traffic deploy or schedule with CS.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: started build 4882 for branch hotfix/0.13.7 -> staging (sha: a1b2c3d). logs: https://ci.internal/builds/4882

maria: can we add a tiny checklist to PR template: release-type: patch|minor|major and tag-format: vX.Y.Z ? then deploy-bot can reject if missing.

elly: (typo: ellie) — +1 to PR label. automation helps.

tyler: propose a short policy we can paste into the release playbook:
```
- Patch: backwards-compatible bugfixes, infra-only changes, non-user-facing perf improvements
- Minor: new features, changes to defaults, any user-visible behavior change
- Major: breaking API changes or incompatible behavior
Tagging: use `vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH` for release tags. CI build id should go in annotated tag body or release notes, not the tag name.
Hotfix branches: `hotfix/MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH`
PRs must include `release-type:` label.
```

amit: +1. add a line: update Dedicated customers in #customer-success when minor/major rollouts are scheduled.

devon: ok i'll cut v0.13.7 as a patch (hotfix/0.13.7). will push tag `v0.13.7` and add build id in annotated message. i'll update PR template and open a tiny follow-up PR to deploy-bot to require release-type label.

maria: thanks — can you paste the tag command you used so others replicate?

devon: sure:
```
git checkout hotfix/0.13.7
git tag -a v0.13.7 -m "patch: fix deployment race (build 4882)"
git push origin v0.13.7
```

sre-oncall: noted. i'll watch the staging -> prod rollout and bump the oncall if anything spikes.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: staging -> prod promote requested for v0.13.7 by devon (build 4882). awaiting approvals.

maria: small follow-up: add one line to the release notes template to indicate if it's infra-only, so customers scanning the changelog can skip.

devon: will do. thanks all :slightly_smiling_face:
